notes: This file is the reproducibility pin for every record under sim/.
open_pdks_commit is the volare version hash for the sky130 PDK family;
the corner runner reads $PDK_ROOT/$PDK back through its symlink and
refuses to run against a different version unless --allow-pdk-mismatch
is passed (in which case the record carries the mismatch).
process_corners are the basic N/P device sections that actually exist in
the PDK ngspice library (verified against the .lib sections of
(ll/hh/hl/lh and combinations), mismatch sections (*_mm) and the Monte
Carlo section (mc) also exist and are available to experiment manifests
